targets.rawSql: WITH stats AS (SELECT countIf(event='enter_submitted') AS submitted, countIf(event='entry_filled') AS filled FROM trading.bull_put_spread_events WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) SELECT filled / nullIf(submitted, 0) AS value FROM stats
SELECT JSONExtractString(payload, 'state') AS state, count() AS events FROM trading.bull_put_spread_events WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY state ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT ts, event, JSONExtractString(payload, 'state') AS state, JSONExtractString(payload, 'order_status') AS order_status, JSONExtractString(payload, 'reason') AS reason FROM trading.bull_put_spread_events WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT countIf(JSONExtractString(payload, 'state')='PENDING') AS value FROM trading.bull_put_spread_events WHERE event='enter_submitted' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT ts, event, JSONExtractString(payload, 'reason') AS reason FROM trading.bull_put_spread_events WHERE event LIKE 'skip_%' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
